views.name: chunk_view_0
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(id)
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE
  overall_rating BETWEEN 60 AND 65
  AND attacking_work_rate = 'low'
views.description:
Task: Calculate the number of players with an overall rating between 60 and 65 who primarily engage in attack moves rather than defensive work.
Required outputs: the count of players
Filters: overall_

views.name: chunk_view_1
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(
    T.team_api_id
  )
FROM "Team_Attributes" AS T
WHERE
  T.buildUpPlaySpeed >= 60
  AND T.buildUpPlaySpeed < 65
  AND T.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Balanced'
